name: Rin
source:
A girl with a musical talent. Despite this, she saw music only as a hobby and did not believe she could make a career out of it.

However, she loved it when people listened to her play. She would often play in public places to see other people smile and enjoy her music.

[In game description]
translation:
A girl with a musical talent. Despite this, she saw music only as a hobby and did not believe she could make a career out of it.

However, she loved it when people listened to her play. She would often play in public places to see other people smile and enjoy her music.
